title: "rungar serve"
description: "Run the daemon"
---

Run the daemon until SIGINT or SIGTERM. Stopping leaves the runners where they are, and starting adopts them, so restart it to take up a changed configuration: a running job is not disturbed. The other commands ask it what it is doing through the socket it serves them on.

## Usage

```console
$ rungar serve [flags]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `-f`, `--config string` | Configuration file. Default: `/etc/rungar/config.yaml`. |
